start.title: [TODO:fr] The Gate at Dusk
start.text:
[TODO:fr] You sit at the gate of Sodom.
The city laughs loudly under a red sky.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Join the laughter to fit in

wickedness.title: [TODO:fr] The City's Heart
wickedness.text:
[TODO:fr] Cruelty in the streets. The weak are mocked.
Your conscience aches and aches.

strangers.title: [TODO:fr] Two Strangers
strangers.text:
[TODO:fr] Two travelers approach the gate.
Something in them is not of this world.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Bow and offer them your home
[TODO:fr] Warn them off and walk away
[TODO:fr] Demand to know who they are

welcome.title: [TODO:fr] Under Your Roof
welcome.text:
[TODO:fr] They follow you home. Bread is broken.
Outside, the city begins to stir.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Bolt every door and keep watch

mob.title: [TODO:fr] Voices at the Door
mob.text:
[TODO:fr] A crowd shouts. Fists pound the wood.
"Send them out to us!"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Hand the guests over to save yourself
[TODO:fr] Stand in the doorway and refuse

angels_warn.title: [TODO:fr] The Warning
angels_warn.text:
[TODO:fr] The strangers speak. "This city is finished.
Take your family. Leave now."

sons_in_law.title: [TODO:fr] Pleading with Family
sons_in_law.text:
[TODO:fr] Your daughters' betrothed laugh in your face.
"Old man — you dream of fire."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay and try to convince them
[TODO:fr] Beg once more, then turn back home

urge.title: [TODO:fr] Dawn — Take My Hand
urge.text:
[TODO:fr] The angel grips your wrist. "Hurry!
Do not look back. Flee to the hills."

flee.title: [TODO:fr] The Road from the City
flee.text:
[TODO:fr] Your wife and daughters run beside you.
Behind, a roar begins to climb the sky.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Glance back to see if it's real

wife_looks.title: [TODO:fr] She Looked
wife_looks.text:
[TODO:fr] Your wife turns. Her body stills, then whitens.
A pillar of salt in the dawn.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Cry out — and keep running with the girls

aftermath.title: [TODO:fr] Zoar at Sunrise
aftermath.text:
[TODO:fr] Smoke darkens the plain behind you.
You sit in the dust. Spared. Hollow. Alive.
